cards.definition: easy to use or suitable for a particular purpose
cards.example: It is convenient to ride my motorcycle to work.
cards.exampleTranslation: Naik motor ke tempat kerja itu praktis.

cards.definition: to delay an event or plan until a later time
cards.example: We had to postpone the meeting because the manager was sick.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami harus menunda rapat karena manajer sedang sakit.

cards.definition: to start using a plan, system, or law
cards.example: The company will implement a new policy next month.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan akan menerapkan kebijakan baru bulan depan.

cards.definition: to make a copy of digital information so you do not lose it
cards.example: You should always back up your files before updating the software.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kamu harus selalu mencadangkan file-filemu sebelum memperbarui perangkat lunak.

cards.definition: a detailed plan or route for a journey
cards.example: The travel agency sent us our holiday itinerary.
cards.exampleTranslation: Agen perjalanan mengirimkan rencana perjalanan liburan kami.

cards.definition: to do or say something to make people feel more comfortable in a social situation
cards.example: He told a joke to break the ice at the party.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia menceritakan sebuah lelucon untuk mencairkan suasana di pesta itu.

cards.definition: not expensive; reasonably priced
cards.example: They are looking for an affordable apartment near the city center.
cards.exampleTranslation: Mereka sedang mencari apartemen yang harganya terjangkau di dekat pusat kota.

cards.definition: to work together with someone to achieve something
cards.example: Our team needs to collaborate with the marketing department on this project.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tim kami perlu bekerja sama dengan departemen pemasaran dalam proyek ini.

cards.definition: information or comments about something you have done, showing how good it is
cards.example: We welcome feedback from our customers to improve our service.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami menyambut baik masukan dari pelanggan kami untuk meningkatkan layanan kami.

cards.definition: a small and temporary problem with a machine or system
cards.example: A technical glitch caused the website to go down for an hour.
cards.exampleTranslation: Gangguan teknis menyebabkan situs web mati selama satu jam.

cards.definition: happening later than planned or expected
cards.example: Our flight was delayed by two hours due to bad weather.
cards.exampleTranslation: Penerbangan kami tertunda selama dua jam karena cuaca buruk.

cards.definition: to talk to someone you have not seen for a while to find out what they have been doing
cards.translation: berbincang mengejar ketertinggalan kabar, melepas kangen
cards.example: Let's have a coffee this weekend and catch up.
cards.exampleTranslation: Ayo minum kopi akhir pekan ini dan saling bertukar kabar.

cards.definition: familiar with something so that it seems normal or usual
cards.example: She quickly became accustomed to the warm weather in Indonesia.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia dengan cepat menjadi terbiasa dengan cuaca hangat di Indonesia.

cards.definition: a time or date by which something must be finished
cards.example: The deadline for submitting the report is Friday afternoon.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tenggat waktu untuk mengumpulkan laporan adalah Jumat sore.

cards.definition: to formalize a deal or agreement by discussing conditions
cards.example: We managed to negotiate a lower price with the supplier.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami berhasil menegosiasikan harga yang lebih rendah dengan pemasok.

cards.definition: easy for people to use and understand
cards.example: The new app design is much more user-friendly.
cards.exampleTranslation: Desain aplikasi baru ini jauh lebih ramah pengguna.

cards.definition: a place to live, work, or stay in
cards.example: Hotel accommodation is included in the price of the tour.
cards.exampleTranslation: Akomodasi hotel sudah termasuk dalam harga tur.

cards.definition: to have a friendly relationship with someone
cards.example: I get along with my new colleagues very well.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya berhubungan sangat baik dengan rekan kerja baru saya.

cards.definition: completely necessary; extremely important
cards.example: Water is essential for living things.
cards.exampleTranslation: Air sangat penting bagi makhluk hidup.

cards.definition: time spent working after your official working hours
cards.example: He worked six hours overtime this week to finish the project.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia bekerja lembur sini enam jam minggu ini untuk menyelesaikan proyek tersebut.

cards.definition: making or likely to make money or a profit
cards.example: The investment proved to be highly profitable within a year.
cards.exampleTranslation: Investasi tersebut terbukti sangat menguntungkan dalam waktu satu tahun.

cards.definition: to look through information or web pages on the internet
cards.example: I spent an hour browsing the web for a good laptop.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya menghabiskan satu jam menjelajah internet untuk mencari laptop yang bagus.

cards.definition: the place where someone or something is going
cards.example: Bali remains a popular tourist destination for foreigners.
cards.exampleTranslation: Bali tetap menjadi tujuan wisata yang populer bagi orang asing.

cards.definition: to look or seem the same as the people or things around you
cards.example: He wore casual clothes to blend in with the students.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia mengenakan pakaian santai agar berbaur dengan para siswa.

cards.definition: feeling annoyed or less confident because you cannot achieve what you want
cards.example: I feel frustrated when the internet connection keeps dropping.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya merasa kesal ketika koneksi internet terus terputus.

cards.definition: to officially state that you are leaving your job
cards.example: She decided to resign from her position to start her own business.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia memutuskan untuk mengundurkan diri dari jabatannya untuk memulai bisnis sendiri.

cards.definition: a list of matters to be discussed at a meeting
cards.example: The first item on our agenda today is the budget review.
cards.exampleTranslation: Item pertama dalam agenda kita hari ini adalah tinjauan anggaran.

cards.definition: things done to protect systems and networks from digital attacks
cards.example: Companies are investing more money into cybersecurity to prevent data leaks.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan-perusahaan menginvestasikan lebih banyak uang ke dalam keamanan siber untuk mencegah kebocoran data.

cards.definition: to travel around a new place to learn about it
cards.example: We love to explore old towns when we travel.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami suka menjelajahi kota-kota tua saat kami bepergian.

cards.definition: to produce a good effect or opinion in other people's minds
cards.example: Dress professionally to make a good impression at the job interview.
cards.exampleTranslation: Berpakaianlah secara profesional untuk memberikan kesan yang baik pada wawancara kerja.

cards.definition: not wanting to do something and therefore slow to do it
cards.example: Many employees were reluctant to move to the new office branch.
cards.exampleTranslation: Banyak karyawan yang enggan pindah ke cabang kantor yang baru.

cards.definition: the amount of work to be done by a person or organization
cards.example: The department is hiring more staff to reduce the heavy workload.
cards.exampleTranslation: Departemen tersebut merekrut lebih banyak staf untuk mengurangi beban kerja yang berat.

cards.definition: something that you plan to achieve; a goal
cards.example: Our main objective this quarter is to increase sales by ten percent.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tujuan utama kami kuartal ini adalah meningkatkan penjualan sebesar sepuluh persen.

cards.definition: to improve something by getting a newer or better version
cards.example: I need to upgrade my phone because it is running too slowly.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya perlu memperbarui ponsel saya karena kinerjanya sudah terlalu lambat.

cards.definition: relating to a particular nearby area, city, or town
cards.example: When traveling, I always try to taste the local food.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saat bepergian, saya selalu mencoba mencicipi makanan lokal.

cards.definition: completely unexpectedly; by surprise
cards.example: An old school friend called me out of the blue yesterday.
cards.exampleTranslation: Seorang teman lama sekolah menelepon saya secara tiba-tiba kemarin.

cards.definition: not clear, detailed, or definite in mind or expression
cards.example: Her instructions were so vague that nobody knew what to do.
cards.exampleTranslation: Instruksinya sangat tidak jelas sehingga tidak ada yang tahu apa yang harus dilakukan.

cards.definition: arriving or doing something at the correct time; not late
cards.example: Please be punctual for the interview tomorrow morning.
cards.exampleTranslation: Harap tepat waktu untuk wawancara besok pagi.

cards.definition: a long-term plan designed to achieve a specific purpose
cards.example: The marketing strategy helped the brand reach younger audiences.
cards.exampleTranslation: Strategi pemasaran tersebut membantu merek menjangkau audiens yang lebih muda.

cards.definition: old-fashioned and no longer useful or correct
cards.example: This operating system is outdated and no longer receives updates.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sistem operasi ini sudah usang dan tidak lagi menerima pembaruan.

cards.definition: something you buy or keep to remind yourself of a holiday or place
cards.example: I bought a small keychain as a souvenir from Tokyo.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya membeli gantungan kunci kecil sebagai suvenir dari Tokyo.

cards.definition: to arrive at a place, especially where you are expected
cards.example: We waited for an hour, but he didn't show up.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami menunggu selama satu jam, tetapi dia tidak datang.

cards.definition: lasting for only a limited period of time; not permanent
cards.example: They are living in a temporary apartment while their house is repaired.
cards.exampleTranslation: Mereka tinggal di apartemen sementara saat rumah mereka sedang diperbaiki.

cards.definition: a person who manages or oversees a person or activity
cards.example: If you need a day off, you must ask your supervisor first.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jika kamu butuh hari libur, kamu harus meminta izin kepada pengawasmu terlebih dahulu.

cards.definition: to get or buy something, or to learn a new skill
cards.example: Our firm plans to acquire a smaller tech startup next month.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan kami berencana untuk memperoleh perusahaan rintisan teknologi yang lebih kecil bulan depan.

cards.definition: able to exist or work together without problems
cards.example: Is this software compatible with Mac operating systems?
cards.exampleTranslation: Apakah perangkat lunak ini kompatibel dengan sistem operasi Mac?

cards.definition: a flight that takes off or lands later than scheduled
cards.example: The airlines provided snacks to passengers of the delayed flight.
cards.exampleTranslation: Maskapai memberikan camilan kepada penumpang dari penerbangan yang tertunda.

cards.definition: to start a conversation with someone, often a stranger
cards.example: She managed to strike up a conversation with the person sitting next to her on the bus.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia berhasil memulai percakapan dengan orang yang duduk di sebelahnya di dalam bus.

cards.definition: happening or behaving in a way that you expect
cards.example: The plot of the movie was very predictable, but it was still fun.
cards.exampleTranslation: Alur cerita film itu sangat mudah ditebak, tetapi tetap menyenangkan.

cards.definition: to travel regularly between work and home
cards.example: Many people commute from Bogor to Jakarta by train every day.
cards.exampleTranslation: Banyak orang melakukan perjalanan pulang-pergi dari Bogor ke Jakarta dengan kereta setiap hari.

cards.definition: producing a large amount of money or profit
cards.example: He left his job after securing a lucrative business contract.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia meninggalkan pekerjaannya setelah mendapatkan kontrak bisnis yang sangat menguntungkan.

cards.definition: the process of converting information into a secret code to prevent unauthorized access
cards.example: This messaging app uses end-to-end encryption for security.
cards.exampleTranslation: Aplikasi pesan ini menggunakan enkripsi ujung-ke-ujung untuk keamanan.

cards.definition: the place at a port, airport, or border where travelers' goods are examined
cards.example: It took us thirty minutes to pass through customs at the airport.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami butuh waktu tiga puluh menit untuk melewati bea cukai di bandara.

cards.definition: polite conversation about unimportant or casual subjects
cards.example: We made small talk about the weather while waiting for the elevator.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami berbasa-basi tentang cuaca sambil menunggu lift.

cards.definition: feeling worried, nervous, or uneasy about something
cards.example: She felt anxious about speaking in front of a large audience.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia merasa cemas tentang berbicara di depan audiens yang besar.

cards.definition: a person that you work with, especially in a profession
cards.example: I invited my colleagues out for dinner to celebrate my promotion.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya mengundang rekan kerja saya makan malam untuk merayakan promosi saya.

cards.definition: the official written record of what was said and decided during a meeting
cards.example: The secretary distributed the minutes of the meeting to all participants.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sekretaris membagikan notulen rapat kepada semua peserta.

cards.definition: software designed intentionally to damage or disrupt a computer system
cards.example: Never click on suspicious links to protect your computer from malware.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jangan pernah mengklik tautan mencurigakan untuk melindungi komputermu dari malware.

cards.definition: a document given to a passenger showing their seat number and flight details
cards.example: Please show your boarding pass and passport at the gate.
cards.exampleTranslation: Silakan tunjukkan pas naik dan paspor Anda di pintu keberangkatan.

cards.definition: an informal meeting or social gathering
cards.example: We are having a small family get-together this Sunday.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami mengadakan acara kumpul-kumpul keluarga kecil hari Minggu ini.

cards.definition: important, noticeable, or having a major effect
cards.example: There has been a significant increase in online sales this year.
cards.exampleTranslation: Telah terjadi peningkatan signifikan dalam penjualan online tahun ini.

cards.definition: to bring something to an official end or close
cards.example: The company decided to terminate the contract due to poor performance.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan memutuskan untuk mengakhiri kontrak karena kinerja yang buruk.

cards.definition: a presentation or speech intended to persuade someone to buy or support something
cards.example: The entrepreneurs made a brilliant pitch to the investors.
cards.exampleTranslation: Para wirausahawan membuat presentasi penawaran yang cemerlang kepada para investor.

cards.definition: to switch a computer off and on again to clear errors
cards.example: If the system freezes, try to reboot your device.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jika sistem membeku (hang), cobalah untuk menyalakan ulang perangkatmu.

cards.definition: the system of money used in a particular country
cards.example: What is the local currency in Thailand?
cards.exampleTranslation: Apa mata uang lokal di Thailand?

cards.definition: to agree fully with someone; to have the same opinion
cards.example: My brother and I don't always see eye to eye on politics.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kakak saya dan saya tidak selalu sependapat tentang politik.

cards.definition: to make something seem larger, better, or worse than it really is
cards.example: Don't trust everything he says; he tends to exaggerate stories.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jangan percayai semua yang dia katakan; dia cenderung melebih-lebihkan cerita.

cards.definition: a period of time at the start of a new job to see if you are suitable
cards.example: New employees usually have to complete a three-month probation.
cards.exampleTranslation: Karyawan baru biasanya harus menyelesaikan masa percobaan selama tiga bulan.

cards.definition: done or produced four times a year (every three months)
cards.example: We review our financial performance on a quarterly basis.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami meninjau kinerja keuangan kami berdasarkan triwulanan.

cards.definition: to connect two or more digital devices so they have the same information
cards.example: You can sync your contacts from your phone to your cloud account.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kamu bisa menyinkronkan kontak dari ponsel ke akun cloud-mu.

cards.definition: a short stay in a place in the middle of a long journey, usually between flights
cards.example: We have a six-hour layover in Singapore before our flight to London.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami memiliki waktu transit enam jam di Singapura sebelum penerbangan kami ke London.

cards.definition: to maintain contact with someone by calling, writing, or meeting
cards.example: Even though we moved to different cities, we still keep in touch.
cards.exampleTranslation: Meskipun kami pindah ke kota yang berbeda, kami tetap berhubungan.

cards.definition: extremely important or necessary for something
cards.example: Good communication skills are essential for this customer service role.
cards.exampleTranslation: Keterampilan komunikasi yang baik sangat penting untuk peran layanan pelanggan ini.

cards.definition: not present in a place, especially at work or school
cards.example: He was absent from work yesterday because he had a high fever.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia tidak hadir bekerja kemarin karena mengalami demam tinggi.

cards.definition: a document giving details about a company or investment opportunity
cards.example: Please read the company prospectus before buying shares.
cards.exampleTranslation: Silakan baca prospektus perusahaan sebelum membeli saham.

cards.definition: to analyze and solve serious problems for a system or organization
cards.example: The IT team is trying to troubleshoot the server error.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tim IT sedang mencoba memecahkan masalah kesalahan server.

cards.definition: happening later than planned or expected
cards.example: Our train was delayed due to heavy rain and flooding.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kereta kami tertunda karena hujan lebat dan banjir.

cards.definition: to refuse an offer, request, or invitation
cards.example: She had to turn down the job offer because the salary was too low.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia harus menolak tawaran pekerjaan itu karena gajinya terlalu rendah.

cards.definition: able to be easily physically or mentally hurt, influenced, or attacked
cards.example: Old computers are more vulnerable to cyber attacks.
cards.exampleTranslation: Komputer lama lebih rentan terhadap serangan siber.

cards.definition: money that can be paid to someone because they have suffered injury or loss, or for work done
cards.example: The company offered financial compensation for the delayed project.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan menawarkan kompensasi finansial atas proyek yang tertunda.

cards.definition: the joining together of two or more companies to form a single larger one
cards.example: The merger of the two banks created the largest bank in the country.
cards.exampleTranslation: Merger kedua bank tersebut menciptakan bank terbesar di negara ini.

cards.definition: pieces of information used to verify a user's identity (e.g., username and password)
cards.example: Never share your login credentials with anyone.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jangan pernah membagikan kredensial login Anda kepada siapa pun.

cards.definition: the friendly and generous reception and entertainment of guests or strangers
cards.example: Thank you for your wonderful hospitality during our stay.
cards.exampleTranslation: Terima kasih atas keramahan Anda yang luar biasa selama kami tinggal.

cards.definition: to start talking about a specific subject or topic
cards.translation: mengangkat atau mengungkit suatu topik pembicaraan
cards.example: Don't bring up politics during dinner; it always causes an argument.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jangan mengangkat topik politik saat makan malam; hal itu selalu menyebabkan perdebatan.

cards.definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid or prevent
cards.example: With so many cars on the road, traffic jams are inevitable.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dengan begitu banyak mobil di jalan, kemacetan lalu lintas tidak dapat dihindari.

cards.definition: a meeting in which an employee's work is discussed and evaluated
cards.example: I have my annual performance appraisal with the manager tomorrow.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya ada sesi penilaian kinerja tahunan dengan manajer besok.

cards.definition: complete control of the supply of a product or service in a market
cards.example: The government is trying to prevent a monopoly in the oil industry.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pemerintah sedang mencoba mencegah monopoli dalam industri minyak.

cards.definition: the measurement of data capacity that can be transmitted over an internet connection
cards.translation: lebar pita data, kapasitas jaringan internet
cards.example: Streaming videos in 4K requires a high bandwidth.
cards.exampleTranslation: Menonton video secara streaming dalam kualitas 4K memerlukan kapasitas jaringan yang tinggi.

cards.definition: to relax and stop worrying after a period of work or stress
cards.example: Traveling to the beach is my favorite way to unwind.
cards.exampleTranslation: Bepergian ke pantai adalah cara favorit saya untuk melepas penat.

cards.definition: to make the effort to do something, or to annoy/worry someone
cards.example: Don't bother to cook; we can just order some food online.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jangan repot-repot memasak; kita bisa memesan makanan secara online saja.

cards.definition: happening or being done at exactly the same time
cards.example: The live concert was broadcast simultaneously on TV and the internet.
cards.exampleTranslation: Konser langsung itu disiarkan secara bersamaan di TV dan internet.

cards.definition: no longer needed or useful, often leading to job dismissal because the role is gone
cards.translation: diberhentikan karena posisi sudah tidak dibutuhkan, mubazir
cards.example: As the factory closed down, fifty workers were made redundant.
cards.exampleTranslation: Karena pabrik ditutup, lima puluh pekerja diberhentikan karena posisi mereka tidak ada lagi.

cards.definition: a new activity or business business that involves risk or uncertainty
cards.translation: usaha baru yang berisiko, bisnis spekulatif
cards.example: They are seeking financial backing for their new business venture.
cards.exampleTranslation: Mereka sedang mencari dukungan finansial untuk usaha bisnis baru mereka.

cards.definition: done by machines or computers instead of humans
cards.example: The system sends an automated email confirmation after you purchase.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sistem mengirimkan email konfirmasi otomatis setelah Anda membeli.

cards.definition: having or allowing you to see beautiful natural scenery
cards.example: We decided to take the scenic route through the mountains.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami memutuskan untuk mengambil rute yang indah pemandangannya melewati pegunungan.

cards.definition: to depend on or trust someone or something
cards.example: You can always rely on her to deliver projects on time.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kamu selalu bisa mengandalkannya untuk menyelesaikan proyek tepat waktu.

cards.definition: intelligent, complex, or advanced
cards.example: Modern medical software has become highly sophisticated.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perangkat lunak medis modern telah menjadi sangat canggih.

cards.definition: something that encourages you to work harder or do something
cards.example: The company offers a cash incentive to employees who hit targets.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan menawarkan insentif tunai kepada karyawan yang mencapai target.

cards.definition: to close a business and sell its assets to pay off debts
cards.translation: melikuidasi, membubarkan perusahaan dan menjual asetnya
cards.example: The court ordered the company to liquidate its assets to repay banks.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pengadilan memerintahkan perusahaan tersebut untuk melikuidasi asetnya guna membayar kembali bank.

cards.definition: the friendly behavior and entertainment provided to guests
cards.example: Thank you for invitation and your warm hospitality.
cards.exampleTranslation: Terima kasih atas undangannya dan ramah tamah Anda yang hangat.

cards.definition: knowing or realizing that something exists or is happening
cards.example: Employees should be aware of the company's security policies.
cards.exampleTranslation: Karyawan harus mengetahui kebijakan keamanan perusahaan.

cards.definition: a promise or determination to do something
cards.example: Her commitment to the project impressed the manager.
cards.exampleTranslation: Komitmennya terhadap proyek tersebut membuat manajer terkesan.

cards.definition: unsure or slow to act because of uncertainty
cards.example: He was hesitant to accept the job offer immediately.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia ragu-ragu untuk langsung menerima tawaran pekerjaan tersebut.

cards.definition: something that you believe is true without proof
cards.example: Don't make assumptions without checking the facts.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jangan membuat asumsi tanpa memeriksa fakta.

cards.definition: a habit or likelihood to behave in a certain way
cards.example: He has a tendency to overthink simple problems.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia memiliki kecenderungan untuk terlalu memikirkan masalah sederhana.

cards.definition: to keep something in good condition
cards.example: DBAs must maintain database performance regularly.
cards.exampleTranslation: DBA harus menjaga performa database secara rutin.

cards.definition: correct and free from mistakes
cards.example: The report contains accurate information.
cards.exampleTranslation: Laporan tersebut berisi informasi yang akurat.

cards.definition: to affect the way someone thinks or behaves
cards.example: Customer reviews can influence buying decisions.
cards.exampleTranslation: Ulasan pelanggan dapat memengaruhi keputusan pembelian.

cards.definition: fair and sensible
cards.example: The hotel offers rooms at a reasonable price.
cards.exampleTranslation: Hotel tersebut menawarkan kamar dengan harga yang masuk akal.

cards.definition: useful and suitable for real situations
cards.example: The training provided practical skills for work.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pelatihan tersebut memberikan keterampilan yang praktis untuk pekerjaan.

cards.definition: working well without wasting time or resources
cards.example: The new system is more efficient than the old one.
cards.exampleTranslation: Sistem baru tersebut lebih efisien daripada yang lama.

cards.definition: to fail to notice something
cards.example: We overlooked an important detail in the contract.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami melewatkan detail penting dalam kontrak tersebut.

cards.definition: worth the time, effort, or money spent
cards.example: Learning English is a worthwhile investment.
cards.exampleTranslation: Belajar bahasa Inggris adalah investasi yang layak dilakukan.

cards.definition: able to change easily when needed
cards.example: The company offers flexible working hours.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan menawarkan jam kerja yang fleksibel.

cards.definition: able to be trusted or depended on
cards.example: She is one of the most reliable members of the team.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia adalah salah satu anggota tim yang paling dapat diandalkan.

cards.definition: to experience or face something unexpectedly
cards.example: Travelers may encounter delays during bad weather.
cards.exampleTranslation: Wisatawan mungkin menghadapi keterlambatan saat cuaca buruk.

cards.definition: to roughly calculate or judge the value of something
cards.example: We estimate the migration will take two days.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami memperkirakan migrasi akan memakan waktu dua hari.

cards.definition: to decide what is most important
cards.example: You should prioritize urgent tasks first.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kamu harus memprioritaskan tugas yang mendesak terlebih dahulu.

cards.definition: to discuss something to reach an agreement
cards.example: They negotiated a better deal with the supplier.
cards.exampleTranslation: Mereka menegosiasikan kesepakatan yang lebih baik dengan pemasok.

cards.definition: to make something easier to understand
cards.example: Could you clarify your last statement?
cards.exampleTranslation: Bisakah Anda memperjelas pernyataan terakhir Anda?

cards.definition: a suggestion about what should be done
cards.example: Thank you for your recommendation.
cards.exampleTranslation: Terima kasih atas rekomendasi Anda.

cards.definition: another choice or option
cards.example: Do we have an alternative solution?
cards.exampleTranslation: Apakah kita memiliki solusi alternatif?

cards.definition: to help achieve something by giving effort or resources
cards.example: Everyone contributed to the project's success.
cards.exampleTranslation: Semua orang berkontribusi terhadap keberhasilan proyek.

cards.definition: to make someone believe or agree with something
cards.example: She convinced the client to continue the project.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia meyakinkan klien untuk melanjutkan proyek tersebut.

cards.definition: a way of dealing with a problem or task
cards.example: We need a different approach to solve this issue.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kita membutuhkan pendekatan yang berbeda untuk menyelesaikan masalah ini.

cards.definition: a document that lists goods or services and states how much you must pay
cards.example: Please send the invoice to our finance department.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tolong kirimkan faktur ke departemen keuangan kami.

cards.definition: a plan for how money will be spent over a period of time
cards.example: We need to stay within budget for this project.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami harus tetap berada dalam anggaran untuk proyek ini.

cards.definition: the total amount of money a business earns from its activities
cards.example: The company's revenue increased by fifteen percent last year.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pendapatan perusahaan meningkat lima belas persen tahun lalu.

cards.definition: to pay another company to do work or provide services for you
cards.example: Many companies outsource their customer support to other countries.
cards.exampleTranslation: Banyak perusahaan mengalihdayakan dukungan pelanggan mereka ke negara lain.

cards.definition: a person or group with an interest or concern in a business
cards.example: We presented the new strategy to all stakeholders.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami mempresentasikan strategi baru kepada seluruh pemangku kepentingan.

cards.definition: an important stage or event in the development of something
cards.example: Completing the migration was a major milestone for the team.
cards.exampleTranslation: Menyelesaikan migrasi merupakan tonggak pencapaian besar bagi tim.

cards.definition: a plan or suggestion put forward for consideration
cards.example: The client approved our proposal yesterday.
cards.exampleTranslation: Klien menyetujui proposal kami kemarin.

cards.definition: a person or company that sells goods or services
cards.example: We changed our software vendor last month.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami mengganti pemasok perangkat lunak bulan lalu.

cards.definition: the process of obtaining goods or services for a business
cards.example: The procurement team is finalizing the contract with the new supplier.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tim pengadaan sedang menyelesaikan kontrak dengan pemasok baru.

cards.definition: a complete list of items such as goods in stock
cards.example: We need to check the inventory before placing a new order.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami perlu memeriksa persediaan sebelum melakukan pemesanan baru.

cards.definition: a person who owns shares in a company
cards.example: The shareholders voted to approve the merger.
cards.exampleTranslation: Para pemegang saham memberikan suara untuk menyetujui merger tersebut.

cards.definition: to estimate or predict what will happen in the future
cards.example: Analysts forecast steady growth for the next quarter.
cards.exampleTranslation: Para analis memperkirakan pertumbuhan yang stabil untuk kuartal berikutnya.

cards.definition: money paid to an employee when their job ends
cards.example: She received three months of severance pay after the layoff.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia menerima pesangon tiga bulan setelah pemutusan hubungan kerja.

cards.definition: working independently for different companies rather than being employed by one
cards.example: He works as a freelance graphic designer.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia bekerja sebagai desainer grafis lepas.

cards.definition: the detailed organization and movement of goods or resources
cards.example: The logistics team handles shipping and delivery schedules.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tim logistik menangani jadwal pengiriman dan pengantaran.

cards.definition: relating to the selling of goods in large quantities at lower prices
cards.example: They buy fabric at wholesale prices and sell it in their shop.
cards.exampleTranslation: Mereka membeli kain dengan harga grosir dan menjualnya di toko mereka.

cards.definition: a sum of money given back, especially for unwanted or faulty goods
cards.example: The store gave me a full refund for the broken item.
cards.exampleTranslation: Toko itu memberikan pengembalian uang penuh untuk barang yang rusak.

cards.definition: a written promise to repair or replace a product if it breaks within a certain time
cards.example: This laptop comes with a two-year warranty.
cards.exampleTranslation: Laptop ini dilengkapi dengan garansi dua tahun.

cards.definition: a statement that something is unsatisfactory or unacceptable
cards.example: The customer filed a complaint about the late delivery.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pelanggan mengajukan keluhan tentang keterlambatan pengiriman.

cards.definition: permanent software programmed into a hardware device
cards.example: You need to update the router's firmware to fix the bug.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kamu perlu memperbarui firmware router untuk memperbaiki bug.

cards.definition: a piece of software used to fix or improve a program
cards.example: The developers released a patch to fix the security flaw.
cards.exampleTranslation: Para pengembang merilis patch untuk memperbaiki kelemahan keamanan tersebut.

cards.definition: a system that prevents unauthorized access to a computer network
cards.example: The company's firewall blocked the suspicious connection.
cards.exampleTranslation: Firewall perusahaan tersebut memblokir koneksi yang mencurigakan.

cards.definition: someone who gains unauthorized access to computer systems
cards.example: A hacker tried to break into the company's database.
cards.exampleTranslation: Seorang peretas mencoba membobol basis data perusahaan.

cards.definition: an instance of failing to protect data, often through unauthorized access
cards.example: The company informed customers about the data breach.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan tersebut memberi tahu pelanggan tentang kebocoran data tersebut.

cards.definition: a device that connects computers to a network and directs data traffic
cards.example: Restarting the router usually fixes the connection problem.
cards.exampleTranslation: Menyalakan ulang router biasanya memperbaiki masalah koneksi.

cards.definition: to set up a system or device for a particular purpose
cards.example: The technician configured the new server overnight.
cards.exampleTranslation: Teknisi mengonfigurasi server baru itu sepanjang malam.

cards.definition: the part of a system that a user interacts with
cards.example: The app has a simple and clean interface.
cards.exampleTranslation: Aplikasi tersebut memiliki antarmuka yang sederhana dan bersih.

cards.definition: the physical parts of a computer system
cards.example: We need to upgrade the hardware before installing the new software.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami perlu memperbarui perangkat keras sebelum memasang perangkat lunak baru.

cards.definition: a message that informs you about something
cards.example: I received a notification that my password was changed.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya menerima notifikasi bahwa kata sandi saya telah diubah.

cards.definition: an arrangement to pay regularly for a service or product
cards.example: She canceled her streaming subscription to save money.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia membatalkan langganan streaming-nya untuk menghemat uang.

cards.definition: the process of proving that someone or something is genuine
cards.example: The app uses fingerprint authentication for extra security.
cards.exampleTranslation: Aplikasi tersebut menggunakan autentikasi sidik jari untuk keamanan tambahan.

cards.definition: to stop working suddenly, especially a computer or program
cards.example: My laptop crashed while I was saving the file.
cards.exampleTranslation: Laptop saya mengalami crash saat saya menyimpan file.

cards.definition: a delay between an action and its effect, especially in technology
cards.example: The video call had a lot of lag because of slow internet.
cards.exampleTranslation: Panggilan video tersebut mengalami banyak lag karena internet yang lambat.

cards.definition: an official document that allows you to enter a foreign country
cards.example: You need a visa to visit that country for more than 30 days.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kamu memerlukan visa untuk mengunjungi negara itu lebih dari 30 hari.

cards.definition: the bags and suitcases that you take when traveling
cards.example: Please make sure your luggage doesn't exceed the weight limit.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pastikan bagasi kamu tidak melebihi batas berat yang ditentukan.

cards.definition: the process of registering your arrival at a hotel or airport
cards.example: Online check-in opens twenty-four hours before the flight.
cards.exampleTranslation: Check-in online dibuka dua puluh empat jam sebelum penerbangan.

cards.definition: the act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey
cards.example: Please arrive two hours before your flight departure.
cards.exampleTranslation: Harap datang dua jam sebelum keberangkatan penerbangan Anda.

cards.definition: tiredness and confusion caused by traveling across different time zones
cards.translation: jet lag, lelah akibat perbedaan zona waktu
cards.example: It took her two days to recover from jet lag after the long flight.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia membutuhkan dua hari untuk pulih dari jet lag setelah penerbangan panjang itu.

cards.definition: the activity of visiting places of interest in an area
cards.example: We spent the whole afternoon sightseeing in the old town.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami menghabiskan seluruh sore hari berwisata di kota tua itu.

cards.definition: a short trip made for pleasure, often organized as part of a tour
cards.example: The hotel offers a free excursion to a nearby waterfall.
cards.exampleTranslation: Hotel itu menawarkan ekskursi gratis ke air terjun terdekat.

cards.definition: the value of one currency compared to another
cards.example: The exchange rate between rupiah and dollar changes every day.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kurs antara rupiah dan dolar berubah setiap hari.

cards.definition: a long journey traveled by car
cards.example: We are planning a road trip along the coast next summer.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami berencana melakukan road trip menyusuri pantai musim panas depan.

cards.definition: a person you know slightly but who is not a close friend
cards.example: He's just a business acquaintance, not a close friend.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia hanya kenalan bisnis, bukan teman dekat.

cards.definition: causing difficulty, embarrassment, or discomfort
cards.example: There was an awkward silence after his joke fell flat.
cards.exampleTranslation: Ada keheningan yang tidak nyaman setelah leluconnya gagal mengena.

cards.definition: friendly and enjoying being with other people
cards.example: Her outgoing personality makes her popular at work.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kepribadiannya yang mudah bergaul membuatnya populer di tempat kerja.

cards.definition: a meeting of a group of people for a particular purpose
cards.example: We organized a small gathering to welcome the new staff.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami mengadakan pertemuan kecil untuk menyambut staf baru.

cards.definition: a remark that expresses praise or admiration
cards.example: She blushed when he gave her a compliment on her presentation.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia tersipu ketika dia memberinya pujian atas presentasinya.

cards.definition: to say that you are sorry for doing something wrong
cards.example: He apologized for being late to the meeting.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia meminta maaf karena terlambat menghadiri rapat.

cards.definition: a routine task, especially a household one
cards.example: Washing the dishes is my least favorite chore.
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencuci piring adalah pekerjaan rumah yang paling tidak saya sukai.

cards.definition: a short trip made to do a specific task, such as shopping
cards.example: I need to run a few errands before lunch.
cards.exampleTranslation: Saya perlu menyelesaikan beberapa urusan sebelum makan siang.

cards.definition: to notice, understand, or interpret something in a particular way
cards.example: Customers perceive the new service as a major improvement.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pelanggan memersepsikan layanan baru tersebut sebagai peningkatan besar.

cards.definition: a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made
cards.example: She faced a dilemma between pursuing her career and moving abroad.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia menghadapi dilema antara mengejar karier dan pindah ke luar negeri.

cards.definition: to distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
cards.example: The manager allocated additional budget to the project.
cards.exampleTranslation: Manajer mengalokasikan anggaran tambahan untuk proyek tersebut.

cards.definition: something that limits what you can do
cards.example: Time constraints prevented us from completing all tasks.
cards.exampleTranslation: Keterbatasan waktu menghalangi kami menyelesaikan semua tugas.

cards.definition: to experience a process or change
cards.example: The database will undergo maintenance this weekend.
cards.exampleTranslation: Database akan menjalani pemeliharaan akhir pekan ini.

cards.definition: possible and practical to achieve
cards.example: The team is evaluating whether the plan is feasible.
cards.exampleTranslation: Tim sedang mengevaluasi apakah rencana tersebut layak dilakukan.

cards.definition: to think that something is smaller or less important than it really is
cards.example: Don't underestimate the importance of regular backups.
cards.exampleTranslation: Jangan meremehkan pentingnya pencadangan rutin.

cards.definition: a deep understanding of a person or situation
cards.example: The report provides valuable insights into customer behavior.
cards.exampleTranslation: Laporan tersebut memberikan wawasan berharga tentang perilaku pelanggan.

cards.definition: following one after another without interruption
cards.example: The server was unavailable for three consecutive days.
cards.exampleTranslation: Server tidak tersedia selama tiga hari berturut-turut.

cards.definition: having a strong desire to achieve success
cards.example: She is ambitious and hopes to become a director one day.
cards.exampleTranslation: Dia ambisius dan berharap menjadi direktur suatu hari nanti.

cards.definition: to give responsibility for a task to another person
cards.example: Good managers know how to delegate responsibilities.
cards.exampleTranslation: Manajer yang baik tahu cara mendelegasikan tanggung jawab.

cards.definition: able to recover quickly from difficulties
cards.example: Small businesses must remain resilient during economic downturns.
cards.exampleTranslation: Usaha kecil harus tetap tangguh selama masa penurunan ekonomi.

cards.definition: to interrupt or cause problems in a process
cards.example: Power outages can disrupt online services.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pemadaman listrik dapat mengganggu layanan online.

cards.definition: the ability to keep employees, customers, or information
cards.example: Employee retention has become a key objective for the company.
cards.exampleTranslation: Retensi karyawan menjadi tujuan utama perusahaan.

cards.definition: unfavorable or harmful
cards.example: The project was affected by adverse weather conditions.
cards.exampleTranslation: Proyek tersebut terdampak kondisi cuaca yang merugikan.

cards.definition: the act of following rules, laws, or standards
cards.example: The audit confirmed compliance with security regulations.
cards.exampleTranslation: Audit tersebut mengonfirmasi kepatuhan terhadap peraturan keamanan.

cards.definition: no longer used because something newer exists
cards.example: Many obsolete systems have been replaced by cloud solutions.
cards.exampleTranslation: Banyak sistem usang telah digantikan oleh solusi cloud.

cards.definition: to ask for information
cards.example: Several customers inquired about the new product launch.
cards.exampleTranslation: Beberapa pelanggan menanyakan peluncuran produk baru.

cards.definition: to remove or take something back
cards.example: The company decided to withdraw its proposal.
cards.exampleTranslation: Perusahaan memutuskan untuk menarik proposalnya.

cards.definition: open and honest; easy to understand
cards.example: Management promised a transparent decision-making process.
cards.exampleTranslation: Manajemen menjanjikan proses pengambilan keputusan yang transparan.

cards.definition: to make a process simpler and more efficient
cards.example: Automation helped streamline the reporting process.
cards.exampleTranslation: Otomatisasi membantu menyederhanakan proses pelaporan.

cards.definition: a person responsible for carrying out a plan or system
cards.example: The implementer worked closely with the technical team.
cards.exampleTranslation: Pelaksana tersebut bekerja sama erat dengan tim teknis.

cards.definition: a standard used for comparison or measurement
cards.example: Customer satisfaction is a benchmark for service quality.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kepuasan pelanggan adalah tolok ukur kualitas layanan.

cards.definition: a possible future event that must be prepared for
cards.example: We created a contingency plan in case the migration failed.
cards.exampleTranslation: Kami membuat rencana darurat jika migrasi gagal.

cards.definition: to make something as effective as possible
cards.example: The DBA optimized the queries to improve performance.
cards.exampleTranslation: DBA mengoptimalkan query untuk meningkatkan performa.
